changelog:
Initial release of gh-fix-ci.

- Enables inspection and triage of failing GitHub Actions PR checks using GitHub CLI.
- Summarizes failing checks and extracts log snippets to propose clear fix plans.
- Implements fixes only after explicit user approval.
- Scopes support to GitHub Actions; external providers (e.g., Buildkite) are reported by URL only.
- Includes a bundled Python script for streamlined check and log fetching.
